I am analyzing the invoice for fraud signals.

The invoice contains two flagged issues: instructions to the reviewer in the item description, and an unknown item not found in the inventory catalog. Automated checks already cover stock levels, pricing, totals, duplicates, revisions, currency, dates, vendors, and amounts near approval limits.

I am checking whether the findings warrant a manual signal. I will not raise a signal that merely restates an automated finding. The five signal categories are pressure language, payment redirect, instruction injection, vendor change, and unusual terms.

The instruction injection finding covers the reviewer instructions. The unknown item finding covers the inventory catalog issue.

The instruction injection finding is a fraud signal. It falls outside the automated check categories. I will not raise a duplicate signal.
